description: Whether a BINARY stays a BINARY through the constructs that pass values along, read off the declared view-column descriptor: a conditional takes its WIDEST branch and is fixed only when EVERY branch is (unlike a union), aggregates and window functions hand their argument's exact type back, CONCAT and || sum what they join, SUBSTR/SUBSTRING/LEFT/RIGHT keep the INPUT's width without narrowing, and REVERSE keeps the whole type including the fixed spelling. All live-measured. Converted 1:1 from expressions/BinaryFamilyThroughConstructsTest (now retired).
